scientific_integrity: The unbounded result is proved by an exhaustive factorization-type argument and an exact invertible algebraic parameterization. The bundled computation is finite regression evidence only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is confined to the canonical low-multiplicity stratum in which both endpoints have at most two prime factors counted with multiplicity. It gives no infinitude or density result for the prime-quadruple parameter set and does not treat either endpoint with Omega at least three.
title: Complete low-multiplicity classification for the gap-two equal-totient equation
